prompt: rust repr packed struct nested repr align member restriction
answer:
Rust forbids a `#[repr(packed)]` struct from containing a `#[repr(align(...))]` type, even transitively through nested structs, unions, or fields. This produces error E0588. The restriction applies even when the packed alignment is at least as large as the aligned type’s alignment.

```rust
#[repr(align(16))]
struct Aligned(i32);

#[repr(packed)]
struct Packed(Aligned); // error[E0588]
```

The restriction exists because GCC and MSVC can disagree about which alignment wins for a type that is both packed and aligned. Rust therefore rejects the ambiguous combination.

The reverse nesting is allowed:

```rust
#[repr(packed)]
struct Packed(i32);

#[repr(align(16))]
struct Aligned(Packed); // allowed
```

Also, `#[repr(packed)]` and `#[repr(align(...))]` cannot be applied to the same type. References to packed fields cannot be created because those fields may be unaligned. (Rust error E0588; Rust `repr` documentation.)
